prompt.task: Modify the supplied parent pure scoring expression once. Lower score wins among safe permutations. Return a different expression, not the unchanged example.

mechanism.example: Prioritize public risk while accounting for deadlines and travel.

contract.safe_div: denominator |d|<1e-6 replaced by same-signed1e-6; zero uses positive sign

example.mechanism: Prioritize public risk while accounting for deadlines and travel.

public_feature_meanings.risk_delay: Mean public weight*risk*(first future completion-now)/deadline over ALL owned tasks; public risk proxy is not calibrated probability.
public_feature_meanings.travel_cost: Current local segment plus bridge travel seconds /300.
public_feature_meanings.freshness_delay: Mean public weight*direct-readout age capped at300s (missing=1)*(first completion-now)/deadline.

prompt.immutable: Only next<=3 unfinished obligations of the current round are permuted; full safety filters all delayed tasks and next cycle. No added checks, transfers, new tasks or safety edits. The original order can win.
prompt.score_label: OFFLINE SIMULATION DEVELOPMENT feedback. These anonymous six conditions are known development data. Online expressions cannot read any evaluation score.

improved_or_unchanged.interpretation: Planned deltas use deterministic same-state geometry, not oracle outcomes. Actual peer deltas match agent/round/task across complete trajectories.

degradation.interpretation: Planned deltas use deterministic same-state geometry, not oracle outcomes. Actual peer deltas match agent/round/task across complete trajectories.

prompt.selection: Safety and numeric validity first; global mean missed segments, then mean censored wait over event conditions, then mean travel, then negative total completions, lexicographic; ties keep parent. Per-condition losses are retained and reported.

selection.rule: Global preregistered lexicographic, not every-condition dominance; ties parent
